questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set. 

{22, 17, 31}
questions.solution:
The logic is:

{22, 17, 31} → 22 - 17 = 5 and 31 - 17 = 14

Similarly,

{31, 26, 40} → 31 - 26 = 5 and 40 - 26 = 14

Hence, ‘**{31, 26, 40}**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: An online entrance exam was conducted in 250 centres all over a country. The average number of applicants per centre was found to be 1250. However, it was later realised that in one centre, the number of applicants was counted as 1758 instead of 1658. What was the correct average number of applicants per centre?
questions.solution:
Total number of exam centres = 250

Average number of applicants per centre = 1250

Total number of applicants = 1250 × 250 = 312500

It was later realised that in one centre, the number of applicants was counted as 1758 instead of 1658.

Correct number of applicants = 312500 + 1658 – 1758

= 314158 – 1758

= 312400

Correct average number of applicants per centre = 312400 ÷ 250 = 1249.6

Hence, ‘**1249.6**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

14 + 12 × 18 ÷ 6 – 12 = 6
questions.solution:
**1. ÷ and ×**

**Given equation: 14 + 12 × 18 ÷ 6 – 12 = 6**

**After interchanging the signs, the equation becomes:**

**L.H.S = 14 + __12 ÷ 18 × 6__ – 12**

**= 14 +__ 0.67 × 6__ - 1**

**= __14 + 4__ – 12**

**= 18 – 12**

**= 6 = R.H.S**

2. × and +

Given equation: 14 + 12 × 18 ÷ 6 – 12 = 6

After interchanging the signs, the equation becomes:

L.H.S = 14 × 12 + **__18 ÷ 6__** – 12

= __**14 × 12**__ + 3 – 12

= __**168 + 3**__ - 12

= 171 – 12

= 159 ≠ R.H.S

3. − and +

Given equation: 14 + 12 × 18 ÷ 6 – 12 = 6

After interchanging the signs, the equation becomes:

L.H.S = 14 - 12 × **__18 ÷ 6__** + 12

= 14 - **__12 × 3__** + 12

= **__14__** – 36 __**+ 12**__

= 26 – 36

= -10 ≠ R.H.S

4. ÷ and –

Given equation: 14 + 12 × 18 ÷ 6 – 12 = 6

After interchanging the signs, the equation becomes:

L.H.S = 14 + 12 × 18 - **__6 ÷ 12__**

= 14 + **__12 × 18__** - 0.5

= __**14 + 216**__ – 0.5

= 230 – 0.5

= 229.5 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘**÷ and ×**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K O _ M C L _ Q M C M O _ M _ N O Q _ C
questions.solution:
Given :- K O _ M C L _ Q M C M O _ M _ N O Q _ C

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1. Q, O, C, Q, M → K O Q M C / L O Q M C / M O C M Q / N O Q M C

2. Q, O, Q, C, M → K O Q M C / L O Q M C / M O Q M C / N O Q M C 

** ♦ Here 1st letter is increased by +1.**

 ♦ K + 1 = L; L + 1 = M; M + 1 = N

3. M, O, Q, C, M → K O M M C / L O Q M C / M O Q M C / N O Q M C

4. M, O, Q, C, O → K O M M C / L O Q M C / M O Q M C / N O Q O C

 ♦ Option (2) gives a pattern of **K** O Q M C / **L** O Q M C / **M** O Q M C / **N** O Q M C.

Hence, ‘**Q, O, Q, C, M**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

1, 2, 6, 21, ?, 445

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

256 : 13 : : 676 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is: **(2nd number + 3)² = 1st number.**

256 : 13 → (**13** + 3)² = 16² = **256**

Similarly,

676 : ? → (**23** + 3)² = 26² = **676**

Hence, ‘**23**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
From the given options choose the one in which the set of numbers __**do not follow**__** **the same Logic/Rule/Relation as the numbers given in below set.

(12, 36, 132)
questions.solution:
The logic is:

**The first number × 3 = second number**

**The first number × 11 = third number**

(12, 36, 132) → 12 × 3 = 36; 12 × 11 = 132

Option 1: (22, 66, 242) → 22 × 3 = 66; 22 × 11 = 242

**Option 2: (18, 54, 196) → 18 × 3 = 54; 18 × 11 = 198 ≠ 196**

Option 3: (15, 45, 165) → 15 × 3 = 45; 15 × 11 = 165

Option 4: (19, 57, 209) → 19 × 3 = 57; 19 × 11 = 209

Thus, **option 2 is not follow given logic.**

Hence, ‘**(18, 54, 198)**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some men are athletes.

No athlete is a singer.

All singers are dancers.

**Conclusions:**

I. No dancer is an athlete.

II. Some singers are men.

III. Some men are dancers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/080e63bdc45fb024c0651cc57d2b728963f7d24b92e4addb4f5bb118a8123865.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No dancer is an athlete. → False (As, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → Some dancer are not athlete) 

II. Some singers are men. → False (As, Some men are athletes, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → No singers are men)

III. Some men are dancers. → False (As, Some men are athletes, No athlete is a singer and All singers are dancers → Some men are not dancers)

Hence, **none of the conclusions follow**.
